summary: Frontend-only verification of the new top-right X close buttons + bottom padding on the three dealer modals (Add Dealer, Edit Dealer, New Agent) using the Pro account mechanicltz@gmail.com. After a sudo supervisorctl restart expo to pick up the source changes, all three modals now render the X button in the header row and the bottom CREATE/CANCEL (or ADD/CANCEL or SAVE/CANCEL) buttons sit fully inside the 390x844 viewport. X close, modal dismissal, and Save/Create flows all work. No deprecated Expo packages or React Native red screens encountered.

tested_flows.flow: EDIT DEALER modal (dealer detail -> kebab menu -> Edit dealer)
NEW AGENT modal (dealer detail -> kebab menu -> Add agent)

results.agent_appears_in_AGENTS_list: TEST_AGENT_X visible in AGENTS section after ADD

action_items: OPTIONAL CLEANUP: Two test artifacts were created on the mechanicltz@gmail.com Pro account during this run: a dealer named 'TEST_X_DEL_ME' (id b3c49e78-570a-4360-8cf6-9ae5c0bd5e69) and an agent 'TEST_AGENT_X' on that dealer. Main agent can delete via the kebab menu (Delete dealer) if cleanup is desired; otherwise harmless.

OBSERVATION (not requested for fix): The frontend logs Failed to load resource: 401 for 8-10 anonymous GETs before the user signs in (homepage tries to fetch /api/auth/me, dealers cache, etc. without a token). These are harmless but noisy — consider gating those prefetches on token presence.

OBSERVATION: After tapping the dashboard 'DEALER ACCOUNTS' card the first time, the app occasionally bounces back to /login (auth token race during initial render); a re-login + re-tap succeeds. Not part of this review scope but worth noting if user reports it.
critical_code_review_comments: dealers.tsx and dealer/[id].tsx both use the same header-row pattern with flexDirection:'row', justifyContent:'space-between' and Ionicons close icon (size 24) + hitSlop:10 — consistent across the three modals. Good.
All three ScrollViews now have contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 28 }} as claimed. Confirmed at dealers.tsx:345, dealer/[id].tsx:651 and dealer/[id].tsx:825.
add-dealer-close onPress resets the form state (good), edit-dealer-close just sets editing=false (acceptable — editForm is rebuilt by openEditDealer), agent-modal-close sets agentForm=null (good).
dealer/[id].tsx is 1884 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; consider splitting the Edit/Agent modals and the BalanceSection into separate files in a future refactor (not blocking).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (3/3 modals: X present, top-right, closes modal, save still works)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 dealer 'TEST_X_DEL_ME' and 1 agent 'TEST_AGENT_X' on mechanicltz@gmail.com Pro account during the save-still-works regression. No backend seed scripts run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The bug fix for top-right X close on Add Dealer / Edit Dealer / New Agent modals is fully verified on the web preview after restarting expo. Use mechanicltz@gmail.com / Blue321! (rate-limited 5/min). Navigation to /dealers must go through the dashboard 'DEALER ACCOUNTS' card click (router.push('/dealers')) — direct page.goto('/dealers') loses auth and bounces to /login. Edit/Agent modals are launched via the kebab menu testID 'dealer-menu-btn' then 'menu-edit-dealer' / 'menu-add-agent'.
rca_of_issue: Initial test pass showed the X button missing in the DOM even though the source code contained the change. Root cause: the Expo Metro bundler was running under CI mode (reloads disabled per /var/log/supervisor/expo.out.log 'Metro is running in CI mode, reloads are disabled') so saved source edits to dealers.tsx and dealer/[id].tsx were NOT re-bundled until 'sudo supervisorctl restart expo' was run. After restart, the new header row + X icon were correctly served and all flows passed. Mitigation: future bug-fix iterations on frontend should restart expo (or remove CI=true) after editing files so the served bundle matches source.
